mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 34 degrees with clear skies around Badger Ridge Middle School. The moon is in its first quarter phase tonight. Please note that the ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City news today includes an invitation for the public to learn about the Military Ridge State Trail paving project. The meeting is set for December 8 at the Verona Senior Center to cover design plans, trail closures, and construction schedules.
There is plenty to do in town. Today, you can join trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, look forward to yoga at Insight Wellness or pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.

Looking at the report for the first half of November, on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where a woman was found unresponsive in her vehicle. She was later arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Turtle. The Verona Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, so make sure to plan your visit accordingly.
